name: secret-blast-radius
description: What would a malicious npm install steal from this machine or CI runner? Ranked inventory of reachable credentials, known-worm IOCs (Shai-Hulud, @subql, GhostAction), PHP2Shell and PaaS exposure checks, ordered rotation runbook, SARIF. Read-only, offline, never prints secrets.
author: Krrish Kumar (https://github.com/Krrishkumar125)
